content.title: SU Group announces $4.4M contract award, largest in company history
content.summary: SU Group (SUGP) announced a $4.4M win, representing the largest contract in the company’s history. Of the total $4.4M, $3.2M is being recognized as revenue in calendar year 2024 and the balance in calendar year 2025. The company successfully designed and fully installed an integrated security and monitoring system for the hostel and academic building complex at Hong Kong Baptist University.
